creature_families: Evil brutes and heavies: dragon, bile_demon, hell_hound, horny, giant, troll, orc, tentacle
Lords (LORD flag): knight, avatar (avatar is also ONE_OF_KIND)
Undead and skeletal: skeleton, vampire, ghost, floating_spirit (spectator kind)
Arachnids and insects: spider, spiderling, maiden (summons spiderlings), bug, fly
Adventurer-type casters and fighters, also the hero side of parties: wizard, sorceror, witch, druid, time_mage, dark_mistress, monk, samurai, barbarian, archer, thief, dwarfa
Tiers: 10 levels per kind, 9 LevelsTrainValues thresholds (config/creatrs/dragon.cfg:91, imp.cfg:286); powers unlock by PowersLevelRequired
Evolution: GrowUp names a new kind and level (demonspawn to DRAGON at level 5; thief to KNIGHT at level 3; config/creatrs/demonspawn.cfg:92, thief.cfg:92)
Sleep-for-experience on terrain: dragon on LAVA 500, sorceror on GOLD and DENSE_GOLD 200, tentacle on WATER 400

top_creatures.label: Slag Wyrm
top_creatures.why: Tallest clipbox in the set (Size 200 740) and joint-slowest base speed (32, shared by six others). Reads as a tower at 375 wide. Rests on lava to recover.
top_creatures.keep: Tall slow silhouette; resting on a hazard tile to recover
top_creatures.change: Telegraphed fan breath with a glow-up, not a straight flame line; no lair object; our own sigil

top_creatures.label: Gall Brute
top_creatures.why: Fat, trembling body; area gas spell at level 4; immune to poison cloud and wind
top_creatures.keep: Area-denial gas as a readable zone of danger
top_creatures.change: Slow puddle with its own colour and sound; not a bodily-function gag

top_creatures.label: Iron Knight
top_creatures.why: LORD with armour 100 and dexterity 150; reflects spells at level 4 and heals at level 7
top_creatures.change: Visible reflect ring with a short timing window, not a spell list

top_creatures.label: Grave Warden
top_creatures.why: Immune to poison cloud and fear; armour at 5; lightning at 10
top_creatures.keep: Immunity as a counter the player must read
top_creatures.change: Immunity shown as a rune on the body, readable at 375 wide; no lightning

top_creatures.label: Ember Hound
top_creatures.why: Base speed 96 (fast) with flame breath at level 5
top_creatures.keep: Fast pack pursuit with a breath cone
top_creatures.change: Pack size held to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; no crude name-linked behaviour

top_creatures.label: Evolving Hatchling
top_creatures.why: Grows into a new kind at a threshold (demonspawn at level 5; thief at level 3)
top_creatures.keep: A threshold where the creature becomes a new kind
top_creatures.change: Trigger is zone milestones verified by the server, not training points alone

top_creatures.label: Shaft Sprite
top_creatures.why: 75 health, base speed 96, digs from level 1, teleports at level 10; pay 0 and lair size 0
top_creatures.keep: A cheap scout that digs its own route
top_creatures.change: Digs a shortcut into zone data and leaves a fading dust trail

top_creatures.label: Lord of the Hall
top_creatures.why: One-of-a-kind LORD with 3000 health, dexterity 160 and nine powers across levels 1 to 10
top_creatures.keep: A single boss with a power ladder
top_creatures.change: The ladder is three phases, not ten levels; obeys MAX_ATTACKERS = 3

weapon_families: Melee swings: SWING_WEAPON_SWORD and SWING_WEAPON_FIST (config/fxdata/creature.cfg instance1, instance2)
Arrows and navigating missiles: SHOT_ARROW; SHOT_NAVI_MISSILE 40 damage (config/fxdata/magic.cfg:681)
Elemental bolts: SHOT_FIREBALL 30 damage with explosion (magic.cfg:537, :556); SHOT_LIGHTNING 20; SHOT_LIGHTNING_BALL 150 (magic.cfg:1177); SHOT_HAILSTORM 5
Area bombs: SHOT_FIREBOMB 50 damage; SHOT_GRENADE hits creatures and objects; SHOT_TIME_BOMB 300 damage, speed 40 (magic.cfg:1272, :1283)
Ballistic heavies: SHOT_BOULDER 5000 damage, speed 64 (magic.cfg:925); SHOT_SOLID_BOULDER; SHOT_SPIKE
Status-only: SHOT_FREEZE 0 damage, FREEZE flag Duration 125 (magic.cfg:598, :109); slow, fear, chicken, disease, cripple (magic.cfg:1494)
Gas: poison cloud; crazy gas (area gas used by the bile brute)
Traps: boulder, alarm, poison gas (trapdoor.cfg:360), lightning, word of power (trapdoor.cfg:438), lava, TNT (SHOT_TRAP_TNT magic.cfg:1360)
gear_tiers: No gear sets or equipment slots in the config
Armour is a stat on a 0 to 200 scale; 200 is 80 percent absorption; protect spell adds 25 percent (config/creatrs/imp.cfg:26-27)
Armour spell: SpellFlags ARMOUR, Duration 250, self-cast (config/fxdata/magic.cfg:119)
Creature tiers by level: 10 levels, 9 training thresholds (config/creatrs/dragon.cfg:91)
Treasure objects in five sizes: GOLD_HOARD_1 to GOLD_HOARD_5 (config/fxdata/objects.cfg:1341 to :1437)
zones: Lava: wavy liquid, FillStyle 1 (config/fxdata/terrain.cfg:240-250); hurts most kinds by 2 (HurtByLava), druid 8, spiderling 4, dragon and demonspawn 0
Water: wavy liquid, FillStyle 2 (config/fxdata/terrain.cfg:258-268); tentacle sleeps in water for experience (tentacle.cfg:93)
Gold and gems: GOLD (terrain.cfg:41), DENSE_GOLD (terrain.cfg:1073), GEMS; gold door DOOR_MIDAS; sorceror sleeps on gold (sorceror.cfg:93)
Room floors and rooms: treasury, library, prison, torture, training, workshop, temple pool, graveyard, hatchery, lair, barracks, garden, guard post (terrain.cfg slab names)
Doors: wood, braced, steel, magic, secret, midas (config/fxdata/trapdoor.cfg, 17 sections in all)
Hero entrance: default generation interval 350 turns (config/fxdata/rules.cfg:183); per-player SET_GENERATE_SPEED applied at src/lvl_script_commands.c:6222; cap 200 at entrance (rules.cfg:185)
Campaign and level sets: classic, deepdngn, standard, lostlvls (levels/), 13 campaigns (campgns/)

originals.name: Slag Wyrm (boss)
originals.idea: A tall, slow lair brute that rests on a hot tile to recover between phases; its fan breath is telegraphed
originals.change: Telegraphed fan breath; our sigil; rest tile is a zone data flag; obeys MAX_ATTACKERS = 3

originals.name: Gall Brute (zone hazard)
originals.idea: A heavy kind whose area gas denies a zone for a few seconds
originals.keep: Area denial as a readable zone
originals.change: Slow puddle with a sound; no bodily-function gag

originals.name: Iron Knight (lord duellist)
originals.idea: A lord that gains a reflect stance at its fourth rank
originals.change: Visible reflect ring with a timing window (guard and parry row)

originals.name: Grave Warden (immunity counter)
originals.idea: Immune to poison and fear, so the player must bring a different tool
originals.change: Rune shows the immunity; no lightning

originals.name: Evolving Hatchling (tier-up creature)
originals.idea: Reaches a new kind at a threshold
originals.keep: Threshold where the creature becomes a new kind
originals.change: Trigger is zone milestones verified by the server (kill and XP rule)

originals.name: Shaft Sprite (digger scout)
originals.idea: A cheap, fast scout that digs its own shortcut
originals.change: Edits zone data and leaves a dust trail that fades

originals.name: Gilded Vault (zone)
originals.idea: A treasure zone where resting on gold gives experience, with five visual tiers
originals.keep: Rest-to-grow on a resource tile; five visual tiers
originals.change: Our own ore tiles and a bronze ramp

originals.name: Ember Ring (prop look)
originals.idea: A six-tile ring prop with staggered 8-frame loops so the ring never blinks in step
originals.change: Our palette and ring size; a pulse on hit
